$comment: Diagnostic repair transcripts (PRD FR-15). Each entry shows a broken program, the stable diagnostic code the compiler emits, and the repaired program. Validated by tests/corpus.test.ts, which also requires a transcript for every code a single-file compile can emit; `grhm codes <CODE>` and the compiler server's `codes` request serve them. An optional "fix" level ("safe" or "review") declares that `grhm fix --level <fix>` replays the broken program to the fixed one; undeclared entries must keep their diagnostic at level safe.

repairs.name: typo in a style prop
repairs.note: Unknown property; the diagnostic includes a ':color' suggestion.

repairs.name: reference to an undeclared name
repairs.note: count was never declared; declare state before use.

repairs.name: navigation to a route that does not exist
repairs.note: nav targets must match a declared page route.

repairs.name: missing route parameter
repairs.note: path templates require every {param} to be supplied.

repairs.name: arithmetic on a string
repairs.note: Use concat for strings; + is numeric.

repairs.name: list used as a condition
repairs.note: Conditions must be boolean. A list is truthy even when empty, so (if items ...) never showed the empty state; testing the count changes behaviour, hence a review fix.
repairs.broken: (app a (state items (arr)) (page "/" home (if items (txt "Some items") (txt "No items yet"))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (state items (arr)) (page "/" home (if (> (count items) 0) (txt "Some items") (txt "No items yet"))))

repairs.name: number used as a condition
repairs.note: Conditions must be boolean. Comparing against 0 keeps the behaviour, so the fix is safe.

repairs.name: resource error used as a condition
repairs.note: users.error is string | null. The exact spelling (and (not-null users.error) (!= users.error "")) is offered as a suggestion; the idiomatic (not-null ...) guard is a review fix.

repairs.name: wrong argument count in a fn call
repairs.note: double takes one parameter; the diagnostic shows the expected shape.

repairs.name: lambda with the wrong arity for reduce
repairs.note: reduce folds with a two-parameter function (acc x).

repairs.name: dialog without open state
repairs.note: dialog requires :open bound to a boolean state.

repairs.name: stagger without an entrance animation
repairs.note: :stagger sequences the children of an :enter animation.

repairs.name: insert into a column that does not exist
repairs.note: The table declares :name; the diagnostic suggests it for the :nmae typo.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (insert wishes :nmae body.name))) (page "/" home (txt "hi")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (insert wishes :name body.name))) (page "/" home (txt "hi")))

repairs.name: send to a route the api does not declare
repairs.note: send must target a declared (api ...) route with a matching method; the diagnostic re-spells the route from the same-method routes.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (insert wishes :name body.name))) (state n "") (page "/" home (btn "Add" (click (send post "/api/wish" :name n)))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (insert wishes :name body.name))) (state n "") (page "/" home (btn "Add" (click (send post "/api/wishes" :name n)))))

repairs.name: server op used in a page expression
repairs.note: select/insert/update/delete-row only run inside (api ...) handlers; pages read through resources.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (get "/api/wishes" (select wishes))) (page "/" home (txt (count (select wishes)))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (get "/api/wishes" (select wishes))) (data (resource wishes "/api/wishes" :default (arr))) (page "/" home (txt (count wishes.data))))

repairs.name: body field not in the input contract
repairs.note: Routes with (input ...) reject undeclared body fields; declare the field or fix the name.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (input (name string)) (insert wishes :name body.nmae))) (page "/" home (txt "hi")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (input (name string)) (insert wishes :name body.name))) (page "/" home (txt "hi")))

repairs.name: send body missing a required input field
repairs.note: The route contract declares (name string); the send must supply it.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (input (name string)) (insert wishes :name body.name))) (page "/" home (btn "Add" (click (send post "/api/wishes")))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (input (name string)) (insert wishes :name body.name))) (state n "") (page "/" home (btn "Add" (click (send post "/api/wishes" :name n)))))

repairs.name: unknown enum member
repairs.note: Enums are read as name.member; the diagnostic lists the valid members.
repairs.broken: (app a (enum status open closed) (state s status.open) (page "/" home (btn "Done" (click (set s status.finished)))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (enum status open closed) (state s status.open) (page "/" home (btn "Done" (click (set s status.closed)))))

repairs.name: auth guard without an auth declaration
repairs.note: :auth true requires (auth users) so sessions exist.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table notes (id auto) (text string))) (api (get "/api/notes" :auth true (select notes))) (page "/" home (txt "hi")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (auth users) (db (table notes (id auto) (text string))) (api (get "/api/notes" :auth true (select notes))) (page "/" home (txt "hi")))

repairs.name: non-exhaustive match over an enum
repairs.note: match over an enum-typed value must cover every member or end with (else ...).
repairs.broken: (app a (enum status open closed) (state s status.open) (page "/" home (txt (match s ("open" "O")))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (enum status open closed) (state s status.open) (page "/" home (txt (match s ("open" "O") ("closed" "C")))))

repairs.name: live resource without a server
repairs.note: :live true subscribes to the generated server's change feed, so the app must declare (db ...) or (api ...).
repairs.broken: (app a (data (resource notes "/api/notes" :live true)) (page "/" home (each n notes.data (txt n.text))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table notes (id auto) (text string))) (api (get "/api/notes" (select notes))) (data (resource notes "/api/notes" :live true)) (page "/" home (each n notes.data (txt n.text))))

repairs.name: file-input without an uploads declaration
repairs.note: file-input posts to /api/uploads, which only exists when the app declares (uploads ...).
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table t (id auto))) (state photo "") (page "/" home (file-input :label "Photo" :to photo)))
repairs.fixed: (app a (uploads) (db (table t (id auto))) (state photo "") (page "/" home (file-input :label "Photo" :to photo)))

repairs.name: server callback depends on browser globals
repairs.note: Server effect validation follows callbacks and let initializers; use only server-safe functions in an API handler.
repairs.broken: (app a (fn viewport (x) window.inner-width) (api (get "/api/widths" (let ((widths (map viewport (arr 1)))) widths))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (fn viewport (x) x) (api (get "/api/widths" (let ((widths (map viewport (arr 1)))) widths))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))

repairs.name: known scalar used as a list callback
repairs.note: Higher-order list operations require a callable value; replace the numeric binding with a lambda or declared function.

repairs.name: regular expression literal that can never compile
repairs.note: Literal operands of throwing ops (json-parse, chunk, regex-*, url-decode, date-iso) are verified at check time with the builtin the runtime calls; an unterminated character class is rejected before it can throw in a page. There is no mechanical repair for a bad literal.

repairs.name: column references an unknown table
repairs.note: :references must name a declared table; the foreign key targets its id column.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table votes (id auto) (note-id number :references notes))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table notes (id auto) (text string)) (table votes (id auto) (note-id number :references notes))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))

repairs.name: nullable list lookup used as a required number
repairs.note: first, last, nth, and find can return no value; guard with not-null or provide an or-else fallback before arithmetic.

repairs.name: typed callback receives inferred string list elements
repairs.note: List element types flow into declared callback parameters. Supply the numeric elements required by the increment function.
repairs.broken: (app a (fn increment ((value number)) (+ value 1)) (page "/" home (txt (map increment (arr "one" "two")))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (fn increment ((value number)) (+ value 1)) (page "/" home (txt (map increment (arr 1 2)))))

repairs.name: optional input used for a required database column
repairs.note: Optional input fields keep their nullable scalar type. Supply a fallback before storing the value in a required column.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table notes (id auto) (text string))) (api (post "/api/notes" (input (text string :optional true)) (insert notes :text body.text))) (page "/" home (txt "Notes")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table notes (id auto) (text string))) (api (post "/api/notes" (input (text string :optional true)) (insert notes :text (or-else body.text "Untitled")))) (page "/" home (txt "Notes")))

repairs.name: numeric standard library operand
repairs.note: Math operations require non-null numeric inputs. Convert text explicitly; to-num yields null for non-numeric text, so supply an or-else fallback.

repairs.name: parsed number used without a fallback
repairs.note: to-num and date-parse return null instead of NaN when the input does not parse; arithmetic needs an or-else fallback or a not-null guard.

repairs.name: Limit excessive expression nesting
repairs.note: Lists nest deeper than the 256-level parse budget; flatten the expression.

repairs.name: private upload policy requires authentication
repairs.note: Declare auth before using owner-only upload storage.

repairs.name: inverted input range
repairs.note: Input constraints must have a valid range.

repairs.name: literal mutation exceeds input range
repairs.note: Literal sends are checked against declared bounds.
repairs.broken: (app a (api (post "/api/n" (input (n number :integer true :min 1 :max 10)) body.n)) (page "/" home (btn "Send" (click (send post "/api/n" :n 11)))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (api (post "/api/n" (input (n number :integer true :min 1 :max 10)) body.n)) (page "/" home (btn "Send" (click (send post "/api/n" :n 5)))))

repairs.name: bounded skeleton generation
repairs.note: Static expansion must remain bounded.

repairs.name: reserved runtime endpoint
repairs.note: Health endpoints cannot be shadowed by application routes.

repairs.name: misspelled operation
repairs.note: cardd is not an operation; the diagnostic offers the nearest one as a safe fix.

repairs.name: misspelled state reference
repairs.note: count is declared; the diagnostic suggests it for the cont typo.

repairs.name: misspelled design token
repairs.note: Token references keep their $ sigil; $primary is the unique nearest token.

repairs.name: seed for a misspelled table
repairs.note: Seeds name a declared table; wishes is the unique nearest one.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string)) (seed wishs (row :name "x"))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string)) (seed wishes (row :name "x"))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))

repairs.name: misspelled send body field
repairs.note: The input contract declares name; the send keyword is re-spelled with its colon.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (input (name string)) (insert wishes :name body.name))) (state n "") (page "/" home (btn "Add" (click (send post "/api/wishes" :nme n)))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (input (name string)) (insert wishes :name body.name))) (state n "") (page "/" home (btn "Add" (click (send post "/api/wishes" :name n)))))

repairs.name: near-miss enum member
repairs.note: status.closd is within edit distance of one member, so the whole read is re-spelled.
repairs.broken: (app a (enum status open closed) (state s status.open) (page "/" home (btn "Done" (click (set s status.closd)))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (enum status open closed) (state s status.open) (page "/" home (btn "Done" (click (set s status.closed)))))

repairs.name: misspelled message key
repairs.note: Message keys come from the locale catalogs; greeting is the unique nearest key.

repairs.name: parsing a request body field that may not be JSON
repairs.note: json-parse throws on malformed input and body.text is only known at runtime, so the handler would answer 500 on bad input. The warning carries a placeholder fix wrapping the call in (attempt … null); the fallback is the author's choice, here a 400 via fail, and bulk fixing never applies placeholders, so this repair stays undeclared.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table notes (id auto) (text string))) (api (post "/api/notes" (json-parse body.text))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table notes (id auto) (text string))) (api (post "/api/notes" (attempt (json-parse body.text) (fail 400 "text must be JSON")))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))

repairs.name: unknown string escape
repairs.note: \w is not an escape. Strings know \n \t \r \" and \\; a literal backslash is written \\.

repairs.name: unterminated string literal
repairs.note: The closing quote is missing, so the string swallows the rest of the file (hence the trailing E003s).

repairs.name: colon without a keyword name
repairs.note: A colon starts a keyword and must be followed by its name.

repairs.name: character outside the grammar
repairs.note: # is not GRHM syntax; comments run from ; to the end of the line.

repairs.name: extra closing parenthesis
repairs.note: One ) too many. Deleting it is offered as a review fix (it may instead mark a missing opener); grhm fix only runs on programs that parse, so apply it by hand or as an editor quick fix.

repairs.name: missing closing parenthesis
repairs.note: The app form is never closed. Appending ) at end of input is a review fix (the missing paren may belong earlier) that grhm fix cannot replay, since the program does not parse.

repairs.name: invalid binding name
repairs.note: Names are lowercase kebab-case so they lower to JavaScript identifiers; underscores are rejected.

repairs.name: keyword without a value
repairs.note: A trailing keyword has no value. Deleting it is a review fix because supplying a value is the other repair.

repairs.name: duplicate declaration
repairs.note: Declarations share one namespace; rename or drop the second n.

repairs.name: duplicate route
repairs.note: Every page needs a distinct, unambiguous route.

repairs.name: element directly inside app
repairs.note: Only declarations sit directly inside (app ...); elements belong to a page or component. The diagnostic lists the allowed forms.

repairs.name: set targeting a function
repairs.note: set writes state or local bindings; double is a fn.
repairs.broken: (app a (fn double (x) (* x 2)) (state n 0) (page "/" home (btn "Go" (click (set double 1)))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (fn double (x) (* x 2)) (state n 0) (page "/" home (btn "Go" (click (set n 1)))))

repairs.name: misspelled resource field
repairs.note: Resources expose data, loading, and error; data is the unique nearest field, so the segment is re-spelled.

repairs.name: resource data read without a default
repairs.note: Without :default the data is empty until the fetch resolves. Declare a default or guard the read with (if users.loading ...); the placeholder fix inserts :default null for the author to type.

repairs.name: image without alt text
repairs.note: Screen readers need :alt. The placeholder fix inserts :alt "" to fill in, so bulk fixing never applies it.

repairs.name: button without a label
repairs.note: A button needs text or an element child for assistive technology; the placeholder fix inserts "Label" to replace.

repairs.name: use without a module string
repairs.note: The module is a string: a package name or a ./ path relative to the project.

repairs.name: interop call to a browser global
repairs.note: The compiler knows nothing about navigator.clipboard.writeText, so only tsc checks the call at build time. Importing a project module declares the binding instead, so references are checked and the generated import is typed.

repairs.name: misspelled test step
repairs.note: Test steps are a fixed vocabulary; expect-text is the unique nearest step.

repairs.name: column with an unknown type
repairs.note: Column types are auto, string, number, or boolean.

repairs.name: refresh of a misspelled resource
repairs.note: refresh names a declared resource; notes is the unique nearest one.

repairs.name: insert missing a required column
repairs.note: Every non-auto, non-optional column without a default must be supplied. The placeholder fix inserts :name "" to fill in.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (insert wishes))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (post "/api/wishes" (insert wishes :name body.name))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))

repairs.name: unsupported :where operator
repairs.note: :where lowers to parameterized SQL and accepts only the listed comparison and logic operators; contains is the substring match.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (get "/api/wishes" (select wishes :where (like name "a%")))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (get "/api/wishes" (select wishes :where (contains name "a")))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))

repairs.name: misspelled :order column
repairs.note: :order names a column of the table; name is the unique nearest column.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (get "/api/wishes" (select wishes :order nmae))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table wishes (id auto) (name string))) (api (get "/api/wishes" (select wishes :order name))) (page "/" home (txt "x")))

repairs.name: locale missing a message
repairs.note: Non-default locales should define every key of the default locale; fr lacks bye.
repairs.broken: (app a (i18n (locale en (msg greeting "Hi") (msg bye "Bye")) (locale fr (msg greeting "Salut"))) (page "/" home (txt (t greeting))))
repairs.fixed: (app a (i18n (locale en (msg greeting "Hi") (msg bye "Bye")) (locale fr (msg greeting "Salut") (msg bye "Au revoir"))) (page "/" home (txt (t greeting))))

repairs.name: job without an interval
repairs.note: A job takes a name, :every seconds, and one body expression; the diagnostic shows the shape.
repairs.broken: (app a (db (table sessions (id auto))) (job prune (delete-row sessions :id 1)) (page "/" home (txt "x")))
repairs.fixed: (app a (db (table sessions (id auto))) (job prune :every 3600 (delete-row sessions :id 1)) (page "/" home (txt "x")))
